subject: Scheduling: procurement readiness & cross-team demo window
messages:
From: Alex Chen <alex.chen@finserv.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>; Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@finserv.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor demo + procurement readiness — availability next week

Hi Karthik / Marissa,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. Procurement asked that we get a short vendor demo together that includes a brief run-through for security and procurement (15–20 min) + a technical Q&A with our cloud engineers (30 min). Ideally we can lock this in before the end of next week so procurement can start their intake.

Attendees we need: procurement (Procurement Team), me (Alex Chen — project lead), and our lead infra engineer Irene Santana. We can be flexible on times but prefer mornings (PST).

Can you share 2–3 windows that work for Redwood (AE + SE + someone from product/infra) and any prep docs you want us to review ahead? Also do you have a short roadmap or mutual action plan we can attach to procurement intake?

Cheers,
Alex

--
Alex Chen
Program Manager, Core Platforms
FinServ Corp
alex.chen@finserv.com

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>

Date: Tue, 15 Sep 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor demo + procurement readiness — availability next week

Alex — thanks for the clear ask and the attendee list. We can do a two-part session: 20-min focused procurement/security overview (AE + Security PM) and a 30–45 min technical Q&A / architecture walkthrough with our SE. Proposed slots (PST):

- Wednesday 23 Sep: 09:00–10:00
- Thursday 24 Sep: 09:30–10:30
- Friday 25 Sep: 08:30–09:30

I’ve cc'd Dylan (SE) and Marissa (AE) — Dylan, can you lead the technical portion and confirm if 45 min is needed? Marissa, I’ll handle the procurement walk-through with an updated MAP (attached).

Attachments: Redwood-MAP-template.xlsx (draft MAP for intake)

If the customer prefers a single 60–75 min block instead of two segments, we can accommodate — let us know. Also, Alex, can procurement share the preferred participant list and if Irene needs VPN/test accounts for the demo?

Best,
Karthik

--
Karthik Iyer

Date: Wed, 16 Sep 2026 08:17:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor demo + procurement readiness — availability next week

Thanks Karthik — I can do Thursday 24 Sep morning but only until 10:15 PST. If you break the session into two parts, I can join both but would prefer the architecture Q&A first. A few quick notes from our infra side:

- We need to understand data residency & retention by default and what options are configurable (esp. logs & KV cache retention).
- Please circulate any security questionnaire answers and a brief SOC/Security summary before the call.
- If you plan to show a live demo hitting our environment, we’ll need a test service account and connection instructions 48 hours prior.

If Thursday at 09:30 for combined session works for Redwood, I can carve out 09:30–10:30 and invite my infra lead.

Thanks,
Irene

Lead Infrastructure Engineer, FinServ Corp

Irene / Alex — I can take the architecture Q&A and I'll plan for 45 minutes to allow for deep-dive on latency/kv-cache/quantization questions. If you want the procurement/security overview first we can do a 15–20 min primer and then jump into the technical block.

Quick asks from my side:
- Can you share a sample prompt/throughput expectation (tokens/sec, concurrency) for the use case?
- Do you want me to include a short runbook for failover and fallback policies?

I’ll prepare a minimal environment diagram and a short slide called "integration checklist" — will upload to the Drive link and share prior to the call.

Thanks,
Dylan

- Alex / Irene: share sample throughput and any security questionnaire pointers — due 24 Sep 07:30 PST.

- Dylan will drop the integration checklist to the Drive and share link in that invite.
